watch.summary: The creator bursts into uncontrollable laughter while reacting to a clip of a robot soccer goalkeeper standing completely motionless during a penalty kick.

beats.what: A humanoid robot kicks a soccer penalty shot.
The goalkeeper robot stands completely frozen as the ball goes past it into the goal.
The creator bursts out laughing loudly at the goalkeeper's uselessness.
The creator mimics the robot's delayed reaction and points out it didn't move for three seconds.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: yeah that dude stood no chance
watch.why: The visual spectacle of high-tech robots failing miserably at basic movement is inherently funny. The creator's loud, infectious laughter and funny commentary highlight the comedy perfectly.
